title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L1076 An Update proposal from the virtual client cannot be committed by any...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Adding an emulator client / Removing emulator clients. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L1076.

Text: "the virtual-client LeafNode MUST be rotated (e.g., by a
Commit with an update path or an Update proposal followed by a Commit)"

Problem: An Update proposal from the virtual client cannot be committed by any emulator client, because RFC 9420 §12.2 forbids committing your own Update. Readers may assume emulator A proposes and emulator B commits. L1408-1409 has the same gap.

Suggested fix: Note that an Update proposal from the virtual client must be committed by a member other than the virtual client. For self-rotation, use a Commit with an UpdatePath.

Severity: low. Verifier: keep (RFC 9420 §12.2 (L4027) makes a Commit invalid if it contains an Update proposal generated by the committer. All emulator clients share one leaf, so 'Update proposal followed by a Commit' (L1076-1077) works only if a non-emulator member commits it, and the text does not say so.)
